step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows New Relic's Synthetic testing platform on AWS. The components are extracted directly from the visual board and transcript. Node 0 (SCHEDULER, EC2) schedules synthetic test jobs into Node 1 (JOB QUEUE, SQS). Node 4 (PUBLIC MONITORS, EC2) pulls jobs from JOB QUEUE to test public websites/APIs (Node 7, ThirdParty). Node 6 (PRIVATE MONITORS, EC2) runs inside customer environments to test private endpoints (Node 8, ThirdParty) and sends results securely back via Node 5 (GLOBAL ACCELERATOR, GlobalAccelerator) to Node 2 (MONITOR API, EC2). Results are pushed into Node 3 (RESULTS QUEUE, SQS) for alerting and dashboarding, completing the loop back to the SCHEDULER.

nodes.name: SCHEDULER
nodes.notes: Schedules synthetic test jobs on a configured time interval (e.g., every minute or hour).

nodes.name: JOB QUEUE
nodes.notes: Stores scheduled synthetic test jobs until runtime monitors pick them up.

nodes.name: MONITOR API
nodes.notes: Receives synthetic test execution results from public and private monitors.

nodes.name: RESULTS QUEUE
nodes.notes: Stores test results for processing, dashboarding, and alerting.

nodes.name: PUBLIC MONITORS
nodes.notes: Public runtime instances (minions) executing tests against public endpoints.

nodes.name: GLOBAL ACCELERATOR
nodes.notes: Provides static IPs for secure, performant routing from private monitors back to the MONITOR API.

nodes.name: PRIVATE MONITORS
nodes.notes: Containerized private monitors (minions) running inside customer private networks/VPCs.

nodes.name: PUBLIC
nodes.notes: Public website or API target tested by public monitors.

nodes.name: PRIVATE
nodes.notes: Private website or API target tested by private monitors inside customer network.

edges.notes: SCHEDULER pushes scheduled jobs into JOB QUEUE.
Connects job processing pipeline towards MONITOR API.
MONITOR API sends test execution results into RESULTS QUEUE.
Feedback loop returning process cycle back to SCHEDULER.
PUBLIC MONITORS pick up scheduled jobs from JOB QUEUE.
PUBLIC MONITORS execute tests against PUBLIC endpoint.
PRIVATE MONITORS execute tests against PRIVATE endpoint.
PRIVATE MONITORS route results upward using static IPs provided by GLOBAL ACCELERATOR.
GLOBAL ACCELERATOR routes traffic securely to MONITOR API.
